headline: Recommended approval of a garage license for Toucan Auto Center at 619 Somerville Avenue.
summary: Minutes from the October 21, 2026 meeting were accepted. The business at 619 Somerville Avenue has operated before this new license. No one spoke at the public hearing.

## City of Somerville, Massachusetts City Council Licenses and Permits Committee Meeting Minutes

Wednesday, November 18, 2026

6:00 PM

This meeting was held via Zoom and was called to order by Chair Hardt at 6:01pm and adjourned at 6:08 pm on a roll call vote of 2 in favor (Councilors Wheeler and Hardt), 1 absent (Councilor Davis).

Others present: Madalyn Letellier - Assistant City Clerk, Legislative Services.

Roll Call

- Present: City Councilor At Large Ben Wheeler and Ward Seven City
- Councilor Emily Hardt

Absent:

Ward Six City Councilor Lance L. Davis

1. Committee

Approval of the Minutes of the Licenses and Permits Committee Meeting of Minutes

October 21, 2026.

(ID # 26-1580 )

- RESULT: ACCEPTED
- AYE:

- City Councilor At Large Wheeler and Ward Seven City
- Councilor Hardt
- ABSENT: Ward Six City Councilor Davis

2. Public Hearing

2.1. License

New Garage License, Toucan Auto Center Inc, 619 Somerville Avenue, 39

(ID # 26-1535 ) vehicles inside, 1 vehicle outside, for autobody work, spray painting, and operating a tow, Mon-Fri: 8am-6pm, Sat: 8am-2pm, Sun: closed.

Chair Hardt shared this is a new garage license, but the business has existed. She confirmed there are no concerns from the City Clerk or the Ward

- Councilor.

Chair Hardt opened the public hearing at 6:04 PM.

- There being no speakers Councilor Hardt closed the public hearing at 6:04
- PM.

RESULT: RECOMMENDED TO BE APPROVED AYE:

- City Councilor At Large Wheeler and Ward Seven City
- Councilor Hardt
- ABSENT: Ward Six City Councilor Davis
